title_en: Visions of the Future (7/20): The Year 2000 on a Postcard
note_en: 不管…都/也… means "no matter how…": 不管想象力多么大胆，有时候现实会超过它 "however bold our imagination may be, reality sometimes outruns it." The 不管 clause usually contains a question word or degree word such as 多么, 什么, or 谁, which here means "however" rather than asking a question. English uses "-ever" words for the same job.
